accuracy_level.label: Behavioral
accuracy_level.description: Reproduces the chip's documented functional behavior (registers, outputs) without modeling internal timing; timing is inferred or ignored.

accuracy_level.label: Cycle-accurate
accuracy_level.description: Matches the original chip's externally observable timing cycle-for-cycle, without necessarily modeling its internal gate structure.

accuracy_level.label: Cycle-approximate
accuracy_level.description: Approximates timing closely enough for correct operation in practice, without guaranteeing cycle-for-cycle fidelity to the original.

accuracy_level.label: Gate-level
accuracy_level.description: Modeled from a reverse-engineered netlist or die image at the logic-gate level; the highest-fidelity band, reproducing internal timing quirks and undocumented behavior.

accuracy_level.label: Partial
accuracy_level.description: A known-incomplete implementation covering only a subset of the chip's documented functionality or modes.
